meta.title: Dynamic Notice Toasts for WooCommerce demo store
meta.description: A WooCommerce store with demo products and a coupon, ready to trigger cart, coupon, and checkout notice toasts.
meta.author: thanosleftheriotis

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; delete_transient( '_wc_activation_redirect' ); WC_Install::create_pages(); foreach ( array( 'cart', 'checkout' ) as $page ) { wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => wc_get_page_id( $page ), 'post_content' => '<!-- wp:shortcode -->[woocommerce_' . $page . ']<!-- /wp:shortcode -->' ) ); } foreach ( array( array( 'Linen Tote Bag', '24.00', false ), array( 'Ceramic Mug', '18.00', false ), array( 'Wool Beanie', '32.00', false ), array( 'Signed Art Print', '45.00', true ) ) as $item ) { $product = new WC_Product_Simple(); $product->set_name( $item[0] ); $product->set_regular_price( $item[1] ); $product->set_sold_individually( $item[2] ); $product->set_status( 'publish' ); $product->save(); } $coupon = new WC_Coupon(); $coupon->set_code( 'toast10' ); $coupon->set_discount_type( 'percent' ); $coupon->set_amount( 10 ); $coupon->save(); flush_rewrite_rules();
